$comment: mothership:dev-only. The two SYNTHETIC disclosure studies. They are not cues: no director kind exists for them, no approved fact is behind them (RULE-003 / D09), and nothing here may be connected to a match. They are kept out of motion-cues.json so that nothing which walks the cue list can reach them. Only design/prototypes/studies.html shows them. docs/design/motion-storyboards.md ends with a fenced section generated from this file.
